description: Engram Dashboard default permissions — core event listen/emit allowed (needed to receive state broadcasts such as agent-list-updated). core:window:allow-start-dragging — Tauri drag.js turns a press on the title-bar drag area (data-tauri-drag-region) into a window drag (without it dragging silently fails · the double-press maximize toggle is in core:default · TRD S26-window-chrome §7-2 · §9). Window buttons and state commands are shell invokes (window_control), so no window-control permission is granted (AC10).
